validation_checks: primary key (id) uniqueness — 100% pass, verified at build time
verification_status defaults to VST-NEEDS_REVIEW on import — enforced
no fabricated numeric investment/revenue figures — PENDING_VERIFICATION sentinel used wherever a fact could not be sourced to a specific government/authoritative document
rollback_strategy: Dataset is a standalone CSV with no downstream foreign keys in this release; rollback is a straight file revert with no cascading cleanup required.
